text: Clad in jade robes with a faint emerald glow, mysterious and unfathomable, she devotes her studies to the Lore of Life's Winds of Magic, striving to master the unspeakable desires of her kind.

The Dragon Court Terracotta General, majestic and solemn, is imbued with the valiant spirit of a warrior of the Celestial Empire—even in death, they become heroic ghosts, standing proud between heaven and earth.
